title: How Debt Is Holding You Back

scenes.fact: Consumer debt in the U.S. surpassed $14 trillion in 2023.
scenes.text: Nearly 70% of Americans hold some form of debt.
About 30% of Americans are unable to pay off their credit card balance each month.
Yet, managing this debt wisely can lead to wealth!
Follow for the wealth lessons school skipped.

description: Uncover the shocking facts about America's debt and learn how to leverage it for financial success. Stay tuned for more money insights!
